result.title: Structure-Preserving Neural Approximation of Convex, Semiconvex, and Quasiconvex Functions
result.summary: Input convex neural networks provide a natural way to enforce convexity globally through architectural constraints. We study how this structure-preserving approximation framework extends to semiconvex, quasiconvex, and convex transformable functions. For $C^{1,1}$ convex functions on compact convex domains, we establish the sharp $W^{1,p}$ minimax rate $m^{-1/d}$ under max-affine approximation with $m$ affine pieces, and show that every max-affine function admits an exact bounded-width ICNN representation with complexity linear in $m$. The same $W^{1,p}$ approximation rate extends to semiconvex functions through quadratic lifting and to convex transformable functions through monotone composition. For general Lipschitz quasiconvex functions, we develop a quantitative finite-probe approximation theory based on monotone responses to affine projections and obtain a structure-preserving IqCNN with an $L^\infty$ approximation guarantee. We further show that these approximation results extend to ReLU-transferable smooth activations, including Softplus and ELU. Numerical experiments on PDE-based approximation problems compare the proposed architectures with parameter-matched MLPs and validation-tuned shape penalties, demonstrating global structural validity without penalty tuning while maintaining competitive approximation accuracy. Overall, the results identify recoverable convex latent structure as the key mechanism enabling gradient-level structure-preserving approximation beyond convexity.

AI.brief_summary: 该文研究输入凸网络的保结构逼近能力，将全局凸性约束扩展到半凸、拟凸及可凸变换函数，给出 max-affine 逼近的尖锐 W^{1,p} 速率，并构造带 L^∞ 保证的 IqCNN，用 PDE 数值实验验证免调惩罚的结构有效性。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 无直接关系，但「可恢复的凸潜结构」、二次提升与单调复合等架构性约束思路，可能为如何限制 latent 推理状态的几何性质、以架构保证任务必要信息不丢失提供可核查的概念类比。
